scanNote:
WORKBOOK 42-BET. Unit 10 — zamonlar, bog'lovchilar, artikllar.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 10-mashq (10 fe'l), 11-mashq (14 fe'l), 12-mashq (10 bog'lovchi), 13-mashq (7 gap birlashtirish), 14-mashq (15 artikl), 15-mashq (4 moslash) — jami 60 ta javob.

⚠ 14-MAShQ — 'THE AMERICANS' TO'G'RI: millat nomi ko'plikda 'the' oladi (Grammar 42-betdagi qoida: 'the Polish, the Italians'). 'THE Smiths' ham shunday — oila nomi ko'plikda.
  ⚠ Lekin shahar, mamlakat va odam nomi artiklsiz: — Rome, — Liverpool, — Jason, — Asia.
  ⚠ Daryo va tog' tizmasi 'the' oladi: THE Tiber, THE Himalayas.

⚠⚠ ESKIRGAN ATAMA: 14-mashqning 5-bandida 'the Zulu TRIBE' deyilgan. 'tribe' so'zi bugun Afrika xalqlariga nisbatan eskirgan; to'g'risi 'the Zulu people' yoki shunchaki 'the Zulu'. Zulular — Janubiy Afrikadagi eng katta xalq (~12 million). Mashq izohiga ogohlantirish qo'shildi.

⚠ 12 va 13-MAShQ — BESh BOG'LOVChI:
  BUT — qarama-qarshilik · BECAUSE — sabab · AND — qo'shish · UNTIL — shu paytgacha · WHEN — vaqt nuqtasi
  ⚠ 12-mashqda har biri IKKI marta ishlatiladi (5 x 2 = 10).
  ⚠ 13-mashqda esa har biri bir martadan, ikkitasi ikki marta (7 gap).

⚠ HALOL QAYD: 15b-mashqning oxirgi ikki namunasida O'ZBEKISTON shaharlari (Toshkent, Samarqand) ishlatilgan — bular kitobda YO'Q, mashq qilish uchun biz qo'shganmiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH ZAMON BELGILARI:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:     every morning/day, often, usually
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS: at the moment, now, at present
  PAST SIMPLE:        in 1996, last summer, yesterday,
                      two months ago

DIQQAT — 'AT PRESENT':
  'at present' = ayni damda ('at the moment' bilan bir xil)
  → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

PRESENT SIMPLE da -S qo'shish:
  I / you / we / they → fe'l
  he / she / it       → fe'l + S

items.textEn: 1  Dad ............ (wash) the car at the moment.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Dad' BIRLIK → IS + washing.

items.textEn: 2  Paul ............ (finish) school in 1996.
items.whyUz: PAST SIMPLE. finish → finished (to'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 3  We ............ (go) to Spain last summer.
items.whyUz: PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.

items.textEn: 4  I ............ (have) bacon and eggs for breakfast every morning.
items.whyUz:
'every morning' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'I' → HAVE (-S YO'Q).
'have breakfast' — 'breakfast' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 5  Mary ............ (write) a letter to her parents yesterday.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. write → WROTE.
'write TO somebody' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 6  My brother ............ (read) a book now.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'My brother' BIRLIK → IS + reading.

items.textEn: 7  Dad ............ (drive) me to school every day.
items.whyUz:
'every day' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Dad' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → drive + S = DRIVES.
'drive somebody TO a place' = kimnidir olib bormoq.

items.textEn: 8  The Johnsons ............ (buy) a new house two months ago.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. buy → BOUGHT.
'The Johnsons' — oila nomi (THE + ko'plik -S).
Grammar 42-betdagi qoida.

items.textEn: 9  It often ............ (rain) in the winter.
items.whyUz:
'often' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'It' 3-shaxs BIRLIK → rain + S = RAINS.
Ob-havo haqida ega DOIM 'it'.

items.textEn: 10  Greg ............ (look) for a new job at present.
items.hintUz: 'at present' — bu 'at the moment' bilan bir xil
items.whyUz:
'at present' = ayni damda → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Greg' BIRLIK → IS + looking.
'look FOR' = qidirmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ DIALOGLARDAN IBORAT —
BIR SUHBATDA BIR NECHA ZAMON BO'LISHI MUMKIN.

SO'ROQ SHAKLLARI:
  PRESENT SIMPLE     → DOES/DO + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS → IS/ARE + ega + fe'l-ING?
  PAST SIMPLE        → DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?

DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI ZAMON:
  'He IS WASHING the car.'      (hozir, ayni damda)
  'He ALWAYS WASHES it on Sundays.'  (odat)
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri — boshqa-boshqa narsani aytadi.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ (your father/work) at the bank?
items.whyUz:
Ish joyi — DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'your father' 3-shaxs birlik → DOES + ASOSIY shakl.
'Does he works' XATO.

items.textEn: 1  B: Not any more. He ............ (stop) working there last month.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. stop → STOPPED ('p' IKKILANADI).
'Not any more' = endi emas.
'stop + fe'l-ing' = ...ni to'xtatmoq.

items.textEn: 2  A: What ............ (Tim/do) at the moment?
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
IS + Tim + DOING.

items.textEn: 2  B: He ............ (wash) the car.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (savolga mos).
'He' → IS + washing.

items.textEn: 2  B: He always ............ (wash) it on Sundays.
items.whyUz:
'always' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'He' → wash + ES = WASHES.
DIQQAT: oxiri 'sh' bo'lsa -ES qo'shiladi.
Oldingi band bilan solishtiring: 'is washing' (hozir) ↔
'washes' (odatda).

items.textEn: 3  A: When ............ (you/finish) school?
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + FINISH (asosiy shakl).

items.textEn: 3  B: I ............ (finish) school two years ago ...
items.whyUz: PAST SIMPLE. finish → FINISHED.

items.textEn: 3  B: ... and now I ............ (study) medicine at university.
items.whyUz:
'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + studying.
ESLATMA: 'now I STUDY medicine' (present simple) ham
grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri — chunki universitetda o'qish
uzoq davom etadigan holat. Lekin 'now' bu kitobda
present continuous belgisi hisoblanadi.

items.textEn: 4  A: Where ............ (you/go) on holiday last summer?
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + GO.
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 4  B: Well, we usually ............ (spend) the summer with my grandparents ...
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'we' KO'PLIK → SPEND (-S YO'Q).
'spend the summer' = yozni o'tkazmoq.

items.textEn: 4  B: ... but last year we ............ (travel) abroad.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. travel → TRAVELLED (britancha).
Amerikacha: traveled.
'abroad' = chet elga — PREDLOGSIZ ('to abroad' XATO).

items.textEn: 5  A: Where ............ (be) the children?
items.whyUz:
Hozirgi holat → PRESENT.
'the children' KO'PLIK → ARE.
'Where are the children?' = Bolalar qayerda?

items.textEn: 5  B: Nick ............ (play) computer games in his room ...
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir nima qilayotgani).
'Nick' BIRLIK → IS + playing.

items.textEn: 5  B: ... and Lucy ............ (watch) TV.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Lucy' BIRLIK → IS + watching.
'watch TV' — artikl YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in with and, when, because, until or but.
exercises.instructionUz: and, when, because, until yoki but so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH BOG'LOVCHI:

  AND     — qo'shimcha ma'lumot, ketma-ketlik
  BUT     — QARAMA-QARShILIK
  BECAUSE — SABAB
  WHEN    — VAQT (o'sha paytda)
  UNTIL   — ...GACHA (harakatning oxiri)

USUL — IKKINCHI QISMGA SAVOL BERING:

  'Nega?' javobi bormi?          → BECAUSE
  Birinchisiga qarshimi?         → BUT
  'Qachon?' javobi bormi?        → WHEN
  'Qachongacha?' javobi bormi?   → UNTIL
  Shunchaki qo'shimchami?        → AND

DIQQAT — 'WHEN' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  WHEN  — harakat O'ShA PAYTDA sodir bo'ladi
     He first played tennis WHEN he was 12.
     (12 yoshida birinchi marta o'ynadi.)
  UNTIL — harakat O'ShA PAYTGACHA davom etadi
     Julie lived with her parents UNTIL she married.
     (Turmushga chiqqunicha ota-onasi bilan yashadi.)

items.textEn: 1  Mother cleaned the house yesterday, ............ she didn't wash the clothes.
items.whyUz:
'cleaned' (tasdiq) ↔ 'didn't wash' (inkor) →
QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.
Oldidan VERGUL qo'yilgan — bu ham 'but' ni ko'rsatadi.

items.textEn: 2  I went to bed early last night ............ I was very tired.
items.whyUz: 'I was very tired' — erta yotishning SABABI → BECAUSE.

items.textEn: 3  He went into the house ............ closed the door behind him.
items.whyUz:
Uyga kirib, eshikni yopish — TABIIY ketma-ketlik → AND.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('he') takrorlanmagan —
bir xil ega bo'lsa tushirsa bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 4  Julie lived with her parents ............ she married Peter.
items.whyUz:
'she married Peter' — yashashning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi →
UNTIL.
Ma'nosi: turmushga chiqqunicha ota-onasi bilan yashadi.

items.textEn: 5  He first played tennis ............ he was 12 years old.
items.whyUz:
'he was 12 years old' — QAChON birinchi marta
o'ynaganini ko'rsatadi → WHEN.
4-band bilan SOLISHTIRING: u yerda 'gacha' (until),
bu yerda 'o'shanda' (when).

items.textEn: 6  I didn't go to Jenny's birthday party ............ I was on holiday.
items.whyUz:
'I was on holiday' — bormaslikning SABABI → BECAUSE.
'ON holiday' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 7  My son started walking ............ he was one year old.
items.whyUz:
'he was one year old' — QAChON yura boshlaganini
ko'rsatadi → WHEN.
5-band bilan bir xil mantiq.

items.textEn: 8  My brother's name is Tom ............ he is an engineer.
items.whyUz:
Ismi va kasbi — QO'ShIMCHA ma'lumot,
qarama-qarshilik yoki sabab YO'Q → AND.
'an engineer' — 'e' unli tovush → AN.

items.textEn: 9  He lived in the same house ............ the day he died.
items.whyUz:
'the day he died' — yashashning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi →
UNTIL.
Coursebook 71-72-betlarda ham shu qolip bor edi:
'She continued travelling UNTIL the day she died.'

items.textEn: 10  He enjoys playing baseball, ............ he doesn't like watching it on TV.
items.whyUz:
'enjoys' (yoqadi) ↔ 'doesn't like' (yoqmaydi) →
QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'enjoy + fe'l-ing' va 'like + fe'l-ing' — ikkalasida ham -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Join the sentences using the following words: but, and, until, because, when.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni quyidagi so'zlar bilan birlashtiring: but, and, until, because, when.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ALOHIDA GAP BERILGAN —
ulardan BITTA gap tuzasiz.

BIRLAShTIRISH USULI:
  1) Ikki gap orasidagi MANTIQIY bog'lanishni toping
  2) Mos bog'lovchini tanlang
  3) Ikkinchi gapning nuqtasini olib tashlab, bog'lovchi
     bilan ulang
  4) Agar ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchisida uni
     tushirib qoldirish mumkin ('and' bilan)

MISOL:
  She sat on the sofa. She started drinking her coffee.
  → She sat on the sofa AND started drinking her coffee.
     (ikkinchi 'she' TUShIB QOLDI)

items.textEn: 1  My father stopped working. He was 65 years old.
items.answer: My father stopped working when he was 65 years old.
items.whyUz:
'He was 65 years old' — ishni to'xtatish QAChON
bo'lganini ko'rsatadi → WHEN.
Ega boshqa ('my father' ↔ 'he'), shuning uchun
'he' saqlanadi.

items.textEn: 2  Mrs Peterson was 45 years old. She looked very young.
items.answer: Mrs Peterson was 45 years old but she looked very young.
items.whyUz:
45 yosh (kattaroq) ↔ yosh ko'rinishi —
QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.
'look + sifat' = ...ko'rinmoq.

items.textEn: 3  He didn't go to school yesterday. He was ill.
items.answer: He didn't go to school yesterday because he was ill.
items.whyUz:
'He was ill' — bormaslikning SABABI → BECAUSE.
'ill' = kasal.

items.textEn: 4  She sat on the sofa. She started drinking her coffee.
items.answer: She sat on the sofa and started drinking her coffee.
items.whyUz:
Divanga o'tirib, kofe icha boshlash — ketma-ketlik → AND.
DIQQAT: ega BIR XIL ('she') → ikkinchisida TUShIB QOLADI.
sit → SAT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'start + fe'l-ing'.

items.textEn: 5  John's family moved to New York. He was a baby.
items.answer: John's family moved to New York when he was a baby.
items.whyUz:
'He was a baby' — ko'chish QAChON bo'lganini ko'rsatadi →
WHEN.
'move TO a place' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 6  She went to the dentist. She had toothache.
items.answer: She went to the dentist because she had toothache.
items.whyUz:
'She had toothache' — borishning SABABI → BECAUSE.
'toothache' = tish og'rig'i — artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 7  We didn't have dinner. Dad came home.
items.answer: We didn't have dinner until Dad came home.
items.whyUz:
'Dad came home' — kutishning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi → UNTIL.
Ma'nosi: dada kelgunicha ovqatlanmadik
(kelgach ovqatlandik).
DIQQAT: 'until' INKOR bilan juda ko'p ishlatiladi.
Grammar 46-betdagi 14-mashqning 5-bandiga o'xshash.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an, the or –.
exercises.instructionUz: a, an, the yoki – (hech narsa) ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDALARNI ESLANG (Grammar 42-betdan):

  THE QO'YILADI:
     daryo nomlari      the Tiber, the Nile
     tog' tizmalari     the Himalayas, the Alps
     millat nomlari     the Americans, the British
     oila nomlari       the Smiths, the Browns
     ilgari aytilgan    the film
     ma'lum narsa       the red car outside

  THE QO'YILMAYDI:
     shahar nomlari     Rome, Liverpool
     qit'a nomlari      Asia
     odam ismlari       Jason
     ovqat nomlari      dinner
     sport nomlari      baseball

  A / AN QO'YILADI:
     birinchi marta, birlik  a river, an excellent film

DIQQAT — 5-BAND ENG MUHIM:
  'There was AN excellent film ... THE film was about ...'
  Birinchi marta → AN;  ikkinchi marta → THE.
  Bu — artikl qoidasining o'zagi.

⚠ ESKIRGAN ATAMA — 'THE ZULU TRIBE':

  5-bandda 'the Zulu TRIBE' deyilgan.

  ⚠ 'tribe' (qabila) so'zi bugungi kunda
  Afrika xalqlariga nisbatan ESKIRGAN va
  ba'zan qo'pol hisoblanadi.

  ⚠ Bugungi to'g'ri variantlar:
     the Zulu PEOPLE
     the Zulu NATION
     yoki shunchaki 'the Zulu'

  ⚠ Zulular — Janubiy Afrikadagi eng katta
  xalq, taxminan 12 million kishi.
  'Qabila' so'zi ularning sonini ham,
  tarixini ham kichraytirib ko'rsatadi.

  ⚠ Grammatik qoida ('the' ishlatiladi)
  TO'G'RI. Xuddi shu qayd Grammar
  42-betda ham bor.

items.whyUz:
'THE Tiber' — DARYO nomi → THE SHART.
Tibr — Rimdan oqib o'tadigan daryo.

items.textEn: 1  ... is ............ river in ...  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'a river' — birinchi marta aytilyapti, BIRLIK → A.
'r' undosh tovush → A.
'Rome' — ShAHAR nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 2  We have ............ dinner at 7 every day.
items.whyUz:
'dinner' — OVQAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
'have dinner AT 7' — soat bilan AT.

items.textEn: 3  ............ Smiths live in ............ Liverpool.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Smiths' — OILA nomi → THE SHART + ko'plik -S.
Ma'nosi: Smitlar oilasi.
DIQQAT: fe'l KO'PLIKDA — 'live' ('lives' EMAS).

items.textEn: 3  ... live in ............ Liverpool.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz: 'Liverpool' — ShAHAR nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 4  ............ red car outside belongs to ............ Jason.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE red car OUTSIDE' — qaysi mashina ekani ANIQ
ko'rsatilgan (tashqaridagi) → THE.
Agar shunchaki 'a red car' bo'lsa, qaysi biri ekani
noma'lum bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 4  ... belongs to ............ Jason.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'Jason' — ATOQLI OT (ism) → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
'belong TO somebody' = kimgadir tegishli bo'lmoq.

items.textEn: 5  There was ............ excellent film on TV last night.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'excellent' — 'e' UNLI tovush → AN.
Film BIRINCHI marta aytilyapti.

items.textEn: 5  ............ film was about ...  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE film' — ILGARI aytilgan film → THE.
DIQQAT — BU ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK:
  AN excellent film  (birinchi marta)
  THE film           (o'sha film)
Grammar 42-betdagi asosiy qoida.

items.textEn: 5  ... was about ............ Zulu tribe.  [3-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Zulu tribe' — QABILA nomi → THE SHART.
Grammar 42-betdagi qoida: 'names of tribes: the Navajo,
the Inuit'.
Zulular — Janubiy Afrikadagi xalq.

items.textEn: 6  ............ Americans like ............ baseball a lot.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Americans' — MILLAT nomi (butun xalq) → THE SHART.
Grammar 42-betdagi qoida: 'nationalities: the Polish,
the Italians'.

items.textEn: 6  ... like ............ baseball a lot.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'baseball' — SPORT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
Grammar 42-betdagi qoida: 'names of sports/games:
basketball, cards'.

items.textEn: 7  ............ Himalayas are in ............ Asia.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Himalayas' — TOG' TIZMASI → THE SHART + ko'plik.
Grammar 42-betdagi qoidada shu misol bor edi.
DIQQAT: fe'l KO'PLIKDA — 'ARE'.

items.textEn: 7  ... are in ............ Asia.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'Asia' — QIT'A nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
Shunga o'xshash: Europe, Africa, America.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SAVOL:
  1  When was your grandmother born?
  2  Where was she born?
  3  When did she marry your grandfather?
  4  How many children did they have?

TO'RT JAVOB:
  A  In Plymouth.
  B  Four.
  C  In August, 1930.
  D  In 1955.

USUL — SAVOL SO'ZIGA QARANG:
  When ...?     → VAQT javobi (C yoki D)
  Where ...?    → JOY javobi (A)
  How many ...? → SON javobi (B)

IKKI 'WHEN' SAVOLINI QANDAY AJRATISH:
  1-savol — TUG'ILISh sanasi → ERTAROQ yil kerak
  3-savol — NIKOH sanasi → KEYINROQ yil kerak
  1930 (tug'ilgan) → 1955 (turmushga chiqqan)
  Ya'ni 25 yoshida turmush qurgan — mantiqan to'g'ri.

DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL TUZILISHI:
  'be born' bilan → WAS/WERE ('did' YO'Q)
     When WAS she BORN?
  boshqa fe'l bilan → DID + ASOSIY shakl
     When DID she MARRY?
     How many children DID they HAVE?

pairs.whyUz:
'When ...?' → VAQT javobi.
TUG'ILISh — eng ERTA sana (1930).
'be born' → 'did' KERAK EMAS.

'Where ...?' → JOY javobi.
Plimut — Angliyaning janubidagi port shahri.

pairs.left: 3  When did she marry your grandfather?
pairs.whyUz:
'When ...?' → VAQT javobi.
NIKOH — tug'ilishdan KEYINROQ (1955).
1930 + 25 = 1955 — 25 yoshida turmush qurgan.
'marry' → 'did' KERAK ('did she MARRY').

pairs.left: 4  How many children did they have?
pairs.whyUz:
'How many ...?' → SON javobi.
'children' — sanaladigan ko'plik.
'did they HAVE' — asosiy shakl.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues about other members of your family.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda oilangizning boshqa a'zolari haqida shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SAVOL QOLIPI:
  When was your ............ born?
  Where was he/she born?
  When did he/she marry ............ ?
  How many children did they have?

OILA A'ZOLARI:
  grandmother  buvi
  grandfather  bobo
  mother       ona
  father       ota
  aunt         xola, amma
  uncle        amaki, tog'a
  parents      ota-ona
  sister       opa, singil
  brother      aka, uka

DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL:
  'be born' → WAS + born ('did' YO'Q)
  boshqa fe'l → DID + ASOSIY shakl

Javoblar SHAXSIY — o'z oilangiz haqida aytasiz.

items.question: When was your grandmother born? — Where was she born? — When did she marry your grandfather? — How many children did they have?
items.answer: In August, 1930. — In Plymouth. — In 1955. — Four.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA javoblari.
'be born' → was;  'marry' va 'have' → did.

items.question: When was your grandfather born? — Where was he born? — When did he marry your grandmother? — How many children did they have?
items.whyUz:
Bobo haqida — 'she' o'rniga 'he'.
Nikoh sanasi va farzandlar soni buvi bilan BIR XIL —
chunki ular er-xotin.

items.question: When was your mother born? — Where was she born? — When did she marry your father? — How many children did they have?
items.whyUz:
Ona haqida.
Javoblar SHAXSIY — o'z oilangiz haqida aytasiz.

items.question: When was your aunt born? — Where was she born? — When did she marry your uncle? — How many children did they have?
items.whyUz:
'an aunt' = xola, amma;  'an uncle' = amaki, tog'a.
Ingliz tilida bu ikkalasi uchun alohida so'z yo'q.

wordFormation.introUz: 42-bet — zamon belgilari, bog'lovchilar, artikllar, oila a'zolari.

groups.explanationUz: Hammasi PRESENT CONTINUOUS ni talab qiladi.

groups.ruleUz: THE + KO'PLIK: oila, millat, tog' tizmasi

patterns.formula: He IS WASHING the car (hozir).  He ALWAYS WASHES it on Sundays (odat).
patterns.exampleEn: He is washing the car. He always washes it on Sundays.
patterns.exampleUz: U hozir mashinani yuvyapti. U doim yakshanbalari uni yuvadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir suhbatda ikki zamon —
chunki ular boshqa-boshqa narsani aytadi.

patterns.formula: 1-gap + WHEN + vaqt gapi.   ↔   1-gap + UNTIL + oxir gapi.
patterns.exampleEn: He first played tennis when he was 12. Julie lived with her parents until she married Peter.
patterns.exampleUz: U 12 yoshida birinchi marta tennis o'ynadi. Juli Piterga turmushga chiqqunicha ota-onasi bilan yashadi.
patterns.explanationUz: WHEN — o'sha PAYTDA;  UNTIL — o'sha paytGACHA.

patterns.exampleEn: She sat on the sofa and started drinking her coffee.
patterns.exampleUz: U divanga o'tirdi va kofe icha boshladi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchi qismda tushirib qoldiriladi.

patterns.formula: There was A/AN + ot ... . THE + o'sha ot ... .
patterns.exampleEn: There was an excellent film on TV last night. The film was about the Zulu tribe.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun televizorda ajoyib film bor edi. Film zulular qabilasi haqida edi.
patterns.explanationUz: Birinchi marta → A/AN;  ikkinchi marta → THE.

patterns.formula: WHEN WAS + ega + BORN?   ↔   WHEN DID + ega + MARRY?
patterns.exampleEn: When was your grandmother born? When did she marry your grandfather?
patterns.exampleUz: Buvingiz qachon tug'ilgan? U bobongizga qachon turmushga chiqqan?

patterns.formula: HOW MANY + ko'plik ot + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
patterns.exampleEn: How many children did they have?
patterns.explanationUz:
'How many' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.
'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl ('have').
